title: Here Comes The Rain Again - Eurythmics

lines.l: Here comes the rain again Falling on my head like a memory
Falling on my head like a new emotion
I want to walk in the open wind I want to talk like lovers do
I want to dive into your ocean Is it raining with you?
Raining in my head like a tragedy
Tearing me apart like a new emotion
I want to breathe in the open wind
I want to kiss like lovers do
I want to dive into your ocean
Falling on my head like a memory
Falling on my head like a new emotion
